q: back-of-envelope 估算里面试官真正在评分的是什么？

why_en: Interviewers grade the reasoning chain, not arithmetic precision, so state assumptions first and reason to an order of magnitude.
options: 算出精确到个位 GB 的最终数字，任何一步算错都直接扣分
先显式列出假设、用量级近似，展示可复查的推理链
背出 A100、GPT-3 的官方参数表，记得越全越显专业
不解释怎么推的，直接甩出一个范围，回答越快越好

State assumptions explicitly and reason to an order of magnitude via a checkable chain.
Recite the official spec sheets of A100 and GPT-3 — the more the better.
Just blurt a range without explaining how you got it; speed is all that matters.
optionExplanations: 面试不看小数点：错一个量级内不致命，死磕个位精度反而错过了考点——推理链。
对；先声明在线比例/精度/利用率这些假设再逐步推量级，「先说假设再算」就是 senior 信号。

Correct — declare assumptions like online ratio, precision, utilization, then step to a magnitude; 'assume before compute' is the senior signal.
Benchmark numbers are for the final sanity-check, not the main line; reciting specs doesn't show derivation.
A range is fine, but without stated assumptions there's no chain to grade and the interviewer can't see your thinking.

q: 补全模型大小（推理）的核心公式：
q_en: Fill in the core model-size (inference) formula:
text: 模型内存（推理）= 参数量 × {{每参数字节数}}；推理估算到这一步就结束。
text_en: Model memory (inference) = parameters × {{bytes_per_parameter}}; for inference the estimate stops here.
why: 公式：参数量 × 每参数字节数；每参数字节数由精度决定（FP32=4、FP16=2、INT8=1）。它是后续算单卡够不够、要不要多卡的基数。
why_en: Model memory equals parameters times bytes-per-parameter, where bytes-per-parameter is set by precision and feeds every downstream GPU-fit decision.

q: 补全每参数字节数随精度的取值：
q_en: Fill in bytes-per-parameter by precision:
text: 每参数字节数看精度：FP32 = {{4}} bytes，FP16/BF16 = {{2}} bytes，INT8 = {{1}} byte。
text_en: Bytes per parameter by precision: FP32 = {{4}} bytes, FP16/BF16 = {{2}} bytes, INT8 = {{1}} byte.
why: FP16 半精度把显存砍半，INT8 量化砍到 1/4；选精度直接决定模型能不能塞进单卡。这些字节数是模型大小公式的乘子。
why_en: FP16 halves memory and INT8 quantization cuts it to a quarter, so precision directly decides whether the model fits a single card.

termDefinitions.meaning: 全精度浮点，每参数 4 字节，传统训练用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FP32 (32-bit floating point) uses 4 bytes per parameter, the traditional full-precision format for training.

termDefinitions.meaning: 半精度浮点，每参数 2 字节，推理与混合精度训练的标准。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FP16/BF16 are half-precision formats at 2 bytes per parameter, standard for inference and mixed-precision training.

termDefinitions.meaning: 8 位整数量化，每参数 1 字节，优化服务用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: INT8 (8-bit integer) quantization uses 1 byte per parameter, used for optimized serving.

scenario: 线上推理服务显存吃紧，想在单卡塞下更大模型，且能容忍轻微精度损失。
scenario_en: An online inference service is memory-constrained, wants a bigger model on one card, and can tolerate slight accuracy loss.
q: 该选哪种数值精度来服务？
q_en: Which numeric precision should you serve with?
why: 选 INT8 量化 = 1 byte/param，显存砍到 FP32 的 1/4、FP16 的 1/2，正好换取「单卡塞更大模型」。代价是量化会掉一点精度。
why_en: Pick INT8 at 1 byte per parameter to cut memory to a quarter of FP32 so a bigger model fits one card, trading a little accuracy.
tradeoff: INT8（显存最省、有精度损失） vs FP16（省一半、精度损失更小）
options: FP32 = 4 byte/param，精度最高但最占显存，塞不下更大模型
FP16/BF16 = 2 byte/param，把显存砍半，精度损失很小
各层凭直觉混用不同精度，边跑边手调，最灵活
INT8 量化 = 1 byte/param，显存砍到 FP32 的四分之一
options_en: FP32 = 4 bytes/param: highest accuracy but most memory, can't fit a bigger model.
FP16/BF16 = 2 bytes/param: halves memory with tiny accuracy loss.
Hand-mix different precisions per layer by intuition, tuning as you go — most flexible.
INT8 quantization = 1 byte/param: cuts memory to a quarter of FP32.
whenOtherWins: 若模型对精度敏感（高精度回归、金融风控），量化掉点太多，就退回 FP16 只砍一半显存换更小的损失。
optionExplanations: FP32 精度最高但最占显存，与「省显存塞更大模型」的目标相反。
FP16 是很好的折中，但题目已说能容忍精度损失且显存最紧，INT8 更省。
凭直觉逐层混精度不可控、难复现，不是标准服务化做法。
对；显存最紧又容忍掉点时选 INT8，1 字节/参数把空间腾出来塞更大模型。
optionExplanations_en: FP32 has top accuracy but the most memory, opposite to 'save memory, fit bigger model'.
FP16 is a fine middle ground, but with tolerance for loss and tightest memory, INT8 saves more.
Ad-hoc per-layer precision is uncontrolled and hard to reproduce, not a standard serving move.
Correct — when memory is tightest and you tolerate loss, INT8 at 1 byte/param frees room for a bigger model.

termDefinitions.meaning: 8 位整数量化，每参数 1 字节，最省显存但有精度损失。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: INT8 (8-bit integer) quantization uses 1 byte per parameter, saving the most memory at some accuracy cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把高精度浮点权重压成低位表示（如 INT8）以省显存、提速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Quantization compresses high-precision float weights into a lower-bit representation (e.g. INT8) to save memory and speed up serving.

q: 套用「参数 × 每参数字节数」公式，这次推理占用的显存落在下列哪个区间？
q_en: Apply the params × bytes-per-parameter formula — which memory range does this inference land in?
why: 公式：7e9 × 2 bytes = 14 GB（FP16 = 2 字节/参数）。它是判断单卡 80 GB HBM 够不够、要不要多卡的基数——别和训练的 84 GB 混。
why_en: 7e9 times 2 bytes equals 14 GB, the base number for deciding whether a single 80 GB HBM card suffices.
options: ~7 GB
~28 GB
~14 GB
~84 GB
options_en: ~7 GB
~28 GB
~14 GB
~84 GB

termDefinitions.meaning: 半精度浮点，每参数 2 字节，推理标准精度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FP16 (16-bit floating point) uses 2 bytes per parameter, the standard precision for inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: GPU 上的高带宽显存，单张 A100 约 80 GB。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HBM (High-Bandwidth Memory) is the GPU's on-package memory; a single A100 has about 80 GB.

scenario: 团队要把一个 7B 参数的模型部署到线上做推理，机型统一用 FP16 精度。
scenario_en: The team is deploying a 7B-parameter model for online inference, standardized on FP16 precision.

q: 补全 Adam + FP32 训练的每参数显存拆解：
q_en: Fill in the per-parameter training memory breakdown for Adam + FP32:
text: Adam + FP32 训练 ≈ 参数 × {{16}} bytes = {{4}}（权重）+ 4（梯度）+ {{8}}（两个动量项）。
text_en: Adam + FP32 training ≈ params × {{16}} bytes = {{4}} (weights) + 4 (gradients) + {{8}} (two momentum terms).
why: 训练除权重外还要存梯度和 Adam 的两个动量项，所以 ≈16 bytes/param，是推理（FP16=2）的约 4–6×；这解释了为什么同一模型训练显存远大于推理。
why_en: Training also stores gradients and Adam's two momentum terms, so about 16 bytes per parameter, roughly 4–6x inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用优化器，除权重外还维护一阶、二阶两个动量项，训练显存翻倍。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Adam (Adaptive Moment Estimation) is a common optimizer that keeps first- and second-moment terms beyond the weights, inflating training memory.

scenario: 要给 7B 模型申请训练卡：同模型 FP16 推理只需 14GB，但训练用 Adam + FP32。
scenario_en: You're requesting GPUs to train a 7B model: FP16 inference needs only 14 GB, but training runs Adam with FP32.

scenario: 7B 模型 FP16 推理只要 14 GB，但用 Adam 混合精度训练要 84 GB+（优化器状态+梯度+激活）。
scenario_en: A 7B model needs 14 GB for FP16 inference but 84 GB+ to train with Adam mixed precision (optimizer states + gradients + activations).
q: 这个 84 GB 的数字带来什么设计后果？
q_en: What design consequence does the 84 GB figure force?
why: 84 GB > 单张 A100 的 80 GB HBM，塞不进一张卡 → 要么把模型/优化器状态跨卡分片（ZeRO、张量并行），要么把优化器状态 offload 到 CPU。这就是「推理能单卡、训练要多卡」的根因。
why_en: 84 GB exceeds a single A100's 80 GB HBM, so you must shard across GPUs (ZeRO/tensor parallel) or offload optimizer state to CPU.
diagram:
flowchart LR I["推理 14 GB"] --> T["训练 84 GB+
+梯度+优化器"] T --> H{"> 80 GB A100 HBM?"} H -->|是| S["分片 / ZeRO / offload"]
options: 超过单卡 80 GB HBM，必须多卡分片或用 ZeRO/offload
无所谓，训练和推理显存一样，14 GB 就够用了
把 batch size 调大一些就能把训练显存压下来，完全不用多卡
换成 CPU 训练就没有显存上限，直接单机跑完
options_en: It exceeds a single card's 80 GB HBM, so you must shard across GPUs or use ZeRO/offload.
No issue — training and inference memory are the same, 14 GB is enough.
Just bump the batch size up a bit and training memory drops — no multi-GPU needed at all.
Train on CPU to remove the memory ceiling and finish on one machine.
optionExplanations: 对；84 GB 塞不进 80 GB HBM，只能分片或 offload，这正是训练要多卡的根因。
反了：训练带梯度+优化器状态，是推理的 4–6×，绝不等同 14 GB。
batch 越大激活越多、显存更吃紧，调 batch 救不了权重+优化器的固定占用。
CPU 训练慢到不可用，且题目问的是 GPU 显存约束，绕开约束不是设计。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — 84 GB won't fit 80 GB HBM, so sharding or offload is required, the reason training needs multiple GPUs.
Backwards: training adds gradients + optimizer state, 4–6x inference, never equal to 14 GB.
Bigger batches add activations and use more memory; batching can't cut the fixed weight+optimizer footprint.
CPU training is unusably slow, and the question is about GPU memory — dodging the constraint isn't a design.

termDefinitions.meaning: GPU 高带宽显存，单张 A100 约 80 GB，模型能否塞进单卡看它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HBM (High-Bandwidth Memory) is GPU memory; a single A100 has ~80 GB, which decides whether a model fits one card.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把优化器状态/梯度/参数切分到多卡，消除冗余以省显存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZeRO (Zero Redundancy Optimizer) shards optimizer states, gradients, and parameters across GPUs to remove redundancy and save memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把优化器状态等从 GPU 挪到 CPU/内存以腾出显存，代价是变慢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Offload moves optimizer state from GPU to CPU/host memory to free HBM, at the cost of speed.

q: 把「从模型规模推到训练要不要多卡」的推理链排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the reasoning chain from model size to the multi-GPU decision for training:
steps: 权重显存 = 7e9 × 2 = 14 GB（推理下限）
定参数量与精度：7B 参数、FP16 = 2 bytes/param
对比单卡 80 GB HBM：训练 84 GB 装不下
加梯度 + Adam 两个动量项 → 训练 ≈ 84 GB
决定跨多卡分片 / ZeRO / offload
why: 先由参数×精度得推理下限，再叠加梯度和优化器状态得训练显存，和 80 GB HBM 一比就知道要不要分片。跳过优化器状态是最常见的低估。
why_en: Derive the inference floor from params times precision, add gradients and optimizer state for the training footprint, then compare to 80 GB HBM to decide sharding.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["7B × FP16"] --> B["权重 14 GB"]
  B --> C["+梯度+Adam ≈ 84 GB"]
  C --> D["> 80 GB HBM"]
  D --> E["多卡分片"]

q: 补全 embedding 存储估算公式：
q_en: Fill in the embedding-storage estimation formula:
text: embedding 存储 = 实体数 × {{维度}} × {{每浮点字节数}} × {{副本数}}。
why: 四个乘子缺一不可，最常被漏的是副本数（replication）；生产常 3x 副本。它是后续算要几块盘、跨几个副本的基数。
why_en: All four multipliers matter, and the most-forgotten is replication; the result feeds how many disks and replicas you provision.
scenario: 为 1 亿用户的推荐系统申请特征库磁盘：embedding 128 维 FP32，生产要求 3 副本。
scenario_en: You're sizing feature-store disk for a 100M-user recommender: 128-dim FP32 embeddings, and prod requires three replicas.

q: 套用存储公式（实体数 × 维度 × 每浮点字节），裸存储落在下列哪个区间？
q_en: Apply the storage formula (entities × dim × bytes-per-float) — which raw-storage range does it land in?
why: 公式：1e9 × 256 × 4 bytes = 1.024e12 ≈ 1 TB（FP32 = 4 字节/浮点）。这个裸数是起点——再乘 3x 副本≈3 TB，还要叠加多版本和特征快照。
why_en: 1e9 × 256 × 4 bytes ≈ 1 TB, the raw base that then multiplies by ~3x replication to ~3 TB before versions and snapshots.
options: ~1 TB
~4 TB
~26 GB
options_en: ~1 TB
~4 TB
~26 GB

termDefinitions.meaning: 全精度浮点，每个浮点 4 字节，embedding 常按它算裸存储。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FP32 (32-bit floating point) is 4 bytes per float, often used to size raw embedding storage.

scenario: 产品要为 10 亿用户各存一条 embedding 向量，先按 FP32 精度估算裸存储。
scenario_en: The product needs to store one embedding vector per user for 1B users, starting with a raw-storage estimate at FP32.

scenario: 有人估 embedding 存储时只算了 1B × 256 × FP32 ≈ 1 TB 就上报了。
scenario_en: Someone estimates embedding storage as just 1B × 256 × FP32 ≈ 1 TB and reports that.
q: 这个估算漏了什么，生产实际要留多少？
q_en: What did this estimate miss, and what should production actually budget?
why: 漏了副本和版本：生产为容灾/读扩展常 3x 副本，再叠加多个模型版本（回滚/AB）。所以 1 TB 的裸数落地常是 3 TB+，漏 replication 是最常见的低估来源。
why_en: It ignored replication and versioning: production typically runs 3x replicas plus multiple model versions, so 1 TB raw becomes 3 TB+.
options: 应该再除以 3：列式压缩对 embedding 矩阵通常能省下三分之二空间
漏了 GPU 显存：落盘存储应按训练用的 GPU 张数再往上乘一遍
没漏：1 TB 就是最终答案，照这个数直接找采购下单即可
漏了副本和版本：生产常 3x 副本 + 多版本，实际按 3 TB 起留余量
options_en: Divide by 3 — columnar compression on an embedding matrix like this usually saves two-thirds of the space.
It missed GPU memory — on-disk storage should be multiplied again by the GPU count used for training.
Nothing missed — 1 TB is the final answer, so hand that number straight to procurement for disk capacity.
It missed replication and versioning: prod runs 3x replicas + multiple versions, so budget from 3 TB up.
optionExplanations: 压缩能省空间但不该默认，且方向反了——生产是往上乘副本，不是往下除。
GPU 显存和落盘存储是两码事，把它乘进存储是概念混淆。
只报裸数会系统性低估，漏掉副本和版本是估存储最常见的坑。
对；乘副本（容灾/读扩展，常 3x）再叠版本（回滚/AB），裸数 1 TB 落地 3 TB+。
optionExplanations_en: Compression can save space but shouldn't be assumed, and the direction is wrong — prod multiplies up for replicas, not down.
GPU memory and on-disk storage are different things; multiplying storage by GPUs conflates them.
Reporting only the raw number systematically underestimates; missing replicas/versions is the classic storage trap.
Correct — multiply by replicas (DR/read-scaling, ~3x) then add versions (rollback/AB), turning 1 TB into 3 TB+.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为容灾和读扩展把数据复制多份，生产常 3x，直接乘进存储量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Replication copies data (commonly 3x) for durability and read-scaling, multiplying total storage.

q: 估 ML 系统总存储时，为什么模型参数量往往是最小的一块？
q_en: When sizing an ML system's total storage, why is the model often the smallest piece?
why: 模型是 GB 级，但特征存储按天快照 × 90 天留存会累积，训练日志常到 PB 级——远超模型。估总量别只盯模型，数据侧才是大头。
why_en: The model is gigabytes, but feature stores compound daily snapshots over 90-day retention and training logs reach petabytes, dwarfing it.
tradeoff: 模型存储（GB 级、静态） vs 训练数据/特征存储（PB 级、随快照×留存累积）
options: 模型参数量在任何规模下都是系统里最大的一块，特征表和训练日志占的空间几乎可以忽略不计
特征只存当前这一份值、从来不保留任何历史快照，所以整体存储自然很小
训练数据和日志一训练完就立刻整批删除，不占长期存储，所以模型最大
特征存储按天快照 × 90 天留存累积，训练日志常达 PB 级，远超模型的 GB 级
options_en: The model is always the biggest piece regardless of scale, and feature tables plus training logs are basically negligible.
Features store only this one current value and never keep any historical snapshot, so total storage naturally stays tiny.
Training data and logs get deleted in one batch right after training and take no long-term storage, so the model is largest.
Feature stores compound daily snapshots over 90-day retention and logs hit petabytes, dwarfing the GB-scale model.
optionExplanations: 恰恰相反：GB 级的模型常是最小项，数据侧才是主导。
特征存储通常保留历史快照做训练/回填，不是只存当前值。
训练数据/日志常长期保留用于复训与审计，不会训练完即删。
对；每日快照 × 90 天留存 + PB 级日志把总量顶上去，模型只是零头。
optionExplanations_en: The opposite: the GB-scale model is usually the smallest term; the data side dominates.
Feature stores usually keep historical snapshots for training/backfill, not just current values.
Training data/logs are often retained long-term for retraining and audit, not deleted after training.
Correct — daily snapshots × 90-day retention plus petabyte logs dominate; the model is a rounding error.

termDefinitions.meaning: 存放模型特征的系统，常按天快照并保留数十天，累积量很大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature store holds model features, often snapshotted daily and retained for weeks, accumulating large volume.

termDefinitions.meaning: 1 PB ≈ 1000 TB ≈ 1e15 字节，大规模训练日志的常见量级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A PB (Petabyte) is about 1000 TB (1e15 bytes), a common scale for large training logs.

scenario: 给日活 1 亿的推荐系统报总存储预算：特征按天快照留存 90 天，训练日志全量保留。
scenario_en: You're budgeting total storage for a recommender with 100M daily users: features snapshot daily with 90-day retention and all training logs are kept.

q: 补全吞吐（要几张 GPU）的估算公式：
q_en: Fill in the throughput (how many GPUs) estimation formula:
text: 所需 GPU 数 = 峰值 QPS ÷ 单卡吞吐，其中单卡吞吐 = {{batch_size}} ÷ {{每 batch 延迟}}。
text_en: Required GPUs = peak QPS ÷ per-GPU throughput, where per-GPU throughput = {{batch_size}} ÷ {{latency_per_batch}}.
why: 需求侧 = 峰值 QPS，供给侧 = 单卡吞吐（每 batch 处理多少 ÷ 处理一 batch 要多久）。QPS = Queries Per Second，这个数决定要买/租多少张卡。
why_en: Demand is peak QPS and supply is per-GPU throughput (batch size over per-batch latency); the result sizes the GPU fleet.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒查询数，吞吐估算的需求侧基数，通常用峰值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: QPS (Queries Per Second) is the demand-side base for throughput estimation, usually taken at peak.

q: 增大推理 batch size 对吞吐和每请求延迟分别有什么影响？
q_en: How does a larger inference batch size affect throughput versus per-request latency?
why: 大 batch 把 GPU 核心喂满 → 吞吐/利用率上去，但请求要等凑够一批 → p99 延迟上去。离线管线偏大 batch，在线低延迟服务偏小 batch。
why_en: A larger batch saturates GPU cores so throughput and utilization rise, but requests wait to fill a batch so p99 latency rises.
tradeoff: 大 batch（吞吐高、利用率高） vs 小 batch/单条（延迟低、实时友好）
diagram:
flowchart LR S["大 batch"] --> U["GPU 核心喂满
吞吐↑ 利用率↑"] S --> L["要等凑够一批
每请求延迟↑"]
options: 吞吐↑、延迟↓，batch 越大 GPU 越忙，纯赚没有代价，应无脑开到最大
吞吐↓、延迟↑，两头都变差，所以生产环境最好完全不做任何 batching
batch size 只决定显存占用峰值，对吞吐和 p99 延迟都没有影响
吞吐↑（GPU 核心喂满、利用率高），但每请求延迟↑（等凑够一批）
options_en: Throughput↑, latency↓ — the bigger the batch the busier the GPU, pure win, so max it out with no downside.
Throughput↓ and latency↑ — both worse, so production should skip batching entirely.
Batch size only sets the peak memory footprint; it has no effect on throughput or p99 latency.
Throughput↑ (cores saturated, high utilization) but per-request latency↑ (waiting to fill a batch).
optionExplanations: 没有纯赚：吞吐涨的代价就是延迟涨，实时服务扛不住。
方向错一半：batch 提吞吐是真的，只是同时抬高了延迟。
batch 直接改变吞吐和延迟，说它只影响显存是错的。
对；大 batch 换吞吐/利用率但牺牲每请求延迟，是最核心的取舍轴。
optionExplanations_en: No pure win: the price of higher throughput is higher latency, which real-time serving can't take.
Half wrong: batching does raise throughput, it just raises latency at the same time.
Batching directly changes throughput and latency; saying it only touches memory is wrong.
Correct — a big batch trades throughput/utilization for per-request latency, the core axis.

termDefinitions.meaning: 99% 请求快于该值的尾延迟，衡量最坏体验，实时服务的关键约束。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: p99 latency is the tail below which 99% of requests complete, the key constraint for real-time serving.

scenario: 在线推荐服务 p99 必须 <100ms，但 GPU 利用率只有 30%，有人提议把推理 batch 调大。
scenario_en: An online recommender must hold p99 under 100 ms, GPU utilization sits at 30%, and someone proposes raising the inference batch size.

scenario: 网约车 ETA 预测要求 p99 < 100ms 的在线响应；另一头是夜间离线特征回填管线。
scenario_en: Ride-share ETA prediction needs an online p99 < 100 ms; the other job is a nightly offline feature-backfill pipeline.
q: 这两种场景该用一样的 batching 策略吗？
q_en: Should both use the same batching strategy?
why: 不该：p99<100ms 是给定的 SLO 目标（不是算出来的），它直接封死大 batch——等不起；离线回填没有延迟约束，才能用大 batch 把 GPU 喂满冲吞吐。
why_en: No — the p99 < 100 ms SLO forbids large batches for online ETA, while offline backfill has no latency budget and can batch big for throughput.
tradeoff: 在线低延迟（小 batch，受 p99 SLO 约束） vs 离线高吞吐（大 batch，无延迟约束）
options: 该：两者都用最大 batch 铺满 GPU，吞吐永远优先，延迟完全不重要
不该：ETA 受 p99 限制小 batch，离线无延迟顾虑大 batch
该：两者都用 batch=1 保证最快响应，延迟永远优先，吞吐完全不重要
无所谓：batch size 只影响显存占用大小，跟延迟和吞吐表现都无关
options_en: Yes: max batch for both to saturate the GPU, throughput always first, latency doesn't matter at all.
No: ETA is capped by p99 to a small batch, while offline backfill has no latency concern and can batch big.
Yes: batch=1 for both to guarantee the fastest response, latency always first, throughput doesn't matter at all.
Doesn't matter: batch size only affects how much memory is used, unrelated to latency or throughput.
whenOtherWins: 若在线服务延迟预算宽松（如秒级的批量推荐），也可以攒一点 micro-batch 换吞吐，不必死守单条。
optionExplanations: 在线全上最大 batch 会击穿 p99<100ms 的 SLO，用户等不起。
对；延迟约束决定 batch：在线被 SLO 封死只能小 batch，离线放开可大 batch。
离线也用 batch=1 会白白浪费吞吐、拖长回填时间，没必要。
batch 直接影响延迟和吞吐，说它只碰显存是错的。
optionExplanations_en: Max batch online blows the p99 < 100 ms SLO; users can't wait.
Correct — the latency constraint sets the batch: online is SLO-capped to small, offline is free to batch big.
Using batch=1 offline wastes throughput and stretches the backfill for no reason.
Batch size directly affects latency and throughput; claiming it only touches memory is wrong.

termDefinitions.meaning: 99% 请求快于该值的尾延迟，实时服务的关键约束。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: p99 latency is the tail below which 99% of requests complete, a key real-time constraint.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务级目标，如 p99<100ms，是给定约束不是算出来的结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SLO (Service-Level Objective) like p99 < 100 ms is a given target, not a computed result.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预计到达时间，网约车里需实时低延迟预测。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival) is the predicted arrival time, needing low-latency real-time inference in ride-share.

q: 同样跑在 GPU 上，稠密矩阵乘和稀疏 embedding 查表的吞吐为什么差很多？
q_en: On the same GPU, why do dense matmuls and sparse embedding lookups have very different throughput?
why: matmul 反复复用同一份数据 → 卡算力（compute-bound），batching 能提吞吐；查表只读一行几乎不算 → 卡显存带宽（bandwidth-bound），batching 帮助小。
why_en: Matmuls reuse data across many ops so they're compute-bound and batch well, while embedding lookups fetch a row and barely compute, so they're bandwidth-bound.
tradeoff: 稠密 matmul（计算受限、吞吐高、batching 有效） vs 稀疏 embedding 查表（带宽受限、吞吐低、batching 帮助小）
diagram:
flowchart TB
  D["稠密 matmul"] -->|计算受限| DH["吞吐高"]
  E["稀疏 embedding 查表"] -->|带宽受限| EH["吞吐低"]
options: 稠密 matmul 计算受限、能喂满核心吞吐高；查表带宽受限、吞吐低
两者吞吐其实一样，只看单卡峰值 FLOPS 就够，op 类型完全不影响
稀疏查表反而更快，因为它做的乘法运算更少、消耗算力也更省
稠密 matmul 反而更慢，因为它涉及的参数更多、要读的数据也更多
options_en: Dense matmul is compute-bound and saturates cores for high throughput; sparse lookup is memory-bandwidth-bound and far lower.
Throughput is actually the same either way — peak FLOPS is all that matters, op type doesn't affect it at all.
Sparse lookup is actually faster because it does fewer multiplications and burns less compute.
Dense matmul is actually slower because it involves more parameters and reads more data.
optionExplanations: 对；matmul 卡算力能 batching 提吞吐，查表卡带宽 batching 帮助小，配卡逻辑不同。
op 类型恰恰决定卡在算力还是带宽，吞吐差别很大，不是只看 FLOPS。
查表算得少不代表快——它卡在随机取数的带宽上，反而吞吐低。
matmul 虽算得多但计算能被喂满，吞吐反而高，方向说反了。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — matmul is compute-bound and batches to high throughput, lookups are bandwidth-bound and batch poorly, so provisioning differs.
Op type is exactly what decides compute- vs bandwidth-bound; throughput differs a lot, not just FLOPS.
Fewer multiplies doesn't mean faster — lookups are bottlenecked on random-access bandwidth, so throughput is low.
Matmul computes more but keeps cores fed, giving higher throughput — the direction is reversed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 瓶颈在算力叫计算受限，瓶颈在显存带宽叫带宽受限，决定 batching 是否有效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Compute-bound means the bottleneck is arithmetic; bandwidth-bound means it's memory bandwidth, which decides whether batching helps.

termDefinitions.meaning: 矩阵乘法，稠密网络的主运算，数据复用高、计算受限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A matmul (matrix multiply) is the main dense-network op, with high data reuse and compute-bound behavior.

scenario: 推理服务里既有稠密的全连接层做矩阵乘，也有从 embedding 表按 id 查一行向量的操作，两者都跑在同一块 GPU 上。
scenario_en: The inference service runs both dense fully-connected matmuls and embedding-table lookups that fetch one row by id, both on the same GPU.

q: 为什么「优化延迟」和「优化吞吐」不能混为一谈？
q_en: Why can't 'optimize latency' and 'optimize throughput' be treated as the same goal?
why: 延迟=单请求多快返回，吞吐=单位时间处理多少；batching 提吞吐却常抬高延迟，两个目标手段相反。先问清哪个约束主导，再选手段。
why_en: Latency is how fast one request returns and throughput is how many per second; batching lifts throughput but raises latency, so the goals pull opposite ways.
tradeoff: 延迟优化（小 batch、就近部署） vs 吞吐优化（大 batch、高利用率）
options: 两者本质是一回事，只要把吞吐拉得够高，延迟就一定会跟着降下来，一起优化就行
延迟只由网络传输时间决定、吞吐只由 CPU 主频和核心数决定，二者互不相关
延迟=单请求多快，吞吐=单位时间处理量；batching 增吞吐反抬延迟
只要一味把吞吐指标往上提高，就总能顺带把延迟也跟着一起降下来
options_en: They're essentially the same thing — pull throughput high enough and latency is bound to drop along with it, so optimize together.
Latency depends only on network transit time and throughput only on CPU clock speed and core count; the two are unrelated.
Latency is per-request speed, throughput is volume per unit time; batching raises throughput but also raises latency.
Just keep pushing the throughput number up and latency will always end up dropping right along with it.
optionExplanations: 反了：提吞吐常靠 batching，恰恰会抬高延迟，两者不是同涨。
延迟和吞吐都受 batch、部署、op 类型影响，不是各管一个硬件。
对；它们是相反方向的目标，先分清哪个约束主导，别用错手段。
一味提吞吐通常牺牲延迟，实时服务会被拖垮，不是顺带双赢。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: raising throughput often uses batching, which raises latency — they don't move together.
Both latency and throughput depend on batch, placement, and op type, not one hardware each.
Correct — they are opposing goals; identify which constraint dominates before choosing a tactic.
Pushing throughput usually sacrifices latency and crushes real-time serving — no free win.
scenario: 同一个推理集群既跑 p99<50ms 的在线请求，又跑夜间离线批打分，团队想用同一套优化手段。
scenario_en: One inference cluster serves online requests with a 50 ms p99 and also runs nightly batch scoring, and the team wants a single optimization playbook.

q: 补全训练时间的估算公式：
q_en: Fill in the training-time estimation formula:
text: 训练时间 = (数据量 × epoch 数 × {{每样本 FLOPs}}) ÷ (GPU 数 × 单卡峰值 FLOPS × {{利用率因子}})。
why: 分子=总计算量，分母=实际算力；最容易漏的是利用率因子（真实 30–50%，不是 100%）。FLOPs=工作量、FLOPS=每秒算力，别混。
why_en: The numerator is total work and the denominator is real compute; the most-forgotten term is the utilization factor, which is 30–50%, not 100%.

termDefinitions.meaning: 浮点运算次数，衡量一次训练的总工作量（小写 s）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FLOPs (Floating-Point Operations) count total arithmetic work, the numerator of training time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒浮点运算数，衡量硬件算力（大写 S）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FLOPS (Floating-Point Operations Per Second) measures hardware compute rate, the denominator.

scenario: 要估 7B 模型在 64 张 A100 上跑 3 个 epoch 需要几天，好决定租一周还是租一个月。
scenario_en: You need to estimate how many days a 7B model takes for three epochs on 64 A100s, to decide whether to rent for a week or a month.

q: 套公式估训练时间时，单卡有效算力该按标称峰值 FLOPS 打几折来算？
q_en: Applying the formula, what fraction of nominal peak FLOPS should effective per-GPU compute be discounted to?
why: 经验法则：真实 GPU 利用率约 30–50%，被 all-reduce、数据加载停顿、流水线气泡吃掉。有效 FLOPS = 峰值×0.3~0.5，忽略它会把训练时间低估 2–3 倍。
why_en: As a rule of thumb, real GPU utilization is 30–50% after all-reduce comms, data-loading stalls, and pipeline bubbles, so effective FLOPS = peak × 0.3–0.5.
options: 100%，直接用标称峰值
恰好 80%
options_en: 100% — use nominal peak directly.
Exactly 80%.
30–50% (rule of thumb).

termDefinitions.meaning: 多卡训练同步梯度的集合通信，是利用率被吃掉的主因之一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: All-reduce is the collective communication that syncs gradients across GPUs, a main reason utilization drops.

termDefinitions.meaning: 有效算力占标称峰值的比例，真实约 30–50%，训练时间分母要乘它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The utilization factor is effective compute over nominal peak, about 30–50% in practice, multiplying the training-time denominator.

scenario: 你在估算一个大模型训练任务要跑多久，已经拿到单卡标称峰值 FLOPS，要决定分母该打几折。
scenario_en: You're estimating how long a large-model training run takes and already have the single-GPU nominal peak FLOPS; you need to discount it for the denominator.

q: 6e18 FLOPs 训练任务在单张 A100 上，耗时落在下列哪个区间？
q_en: For a 6e18-FLOP training job on a single A100, which duration range does it land in?
why: 有效算力 = 312 TFLOPS × 40% ≈ 125e12 FLOPS；6e18 ÷ 125e12 ≈ 48,000 s ≈ 13.3 h。TFLOPS=每秒万亿次浮点运算。这个数用来判断要不要多卡、排期多长。
why_en: Effective compute = 312 TFLOPS × 40% ≈ 125e12 FLOPS, and 6e18 ÷ 125e12 ≈ 48,000 s ≈ 13.3 h.
options: ~13 小时
~5 分钟
options_en: ~13 hours
~1.3 hours
~130 hours
~5 minutes

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒万亿（1e12）次浮点运算，单卡算力单位，A100 FP16 约 312。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TFLOPS (Tera Floating-Point Operations Per Second) is 1e12 ops/sec; an A100 does about 312 in FP16.

scenario: 已经算出训练总共要 6e18 FLOPs，用的是单张 A100（312 TFLOPS FP16，40% 利用率）。
scenario_en: You've already computed the job needs 6e18 FLOPs total, running on a single A100 (312 TFLOPS FP16, 40% utilization).

scenario: 上面算出训练在单张 A100 上约 13 小时，理论上一张卡放得下也跑得完。
scenario_en: The estimate says training fits in ~13 hours on a single A100, which technically holds the job.
q: 实践中为什么还要配 2–4 张卡？
q_en: Why still provision 2–4 GPUs in practice?
why: 单卡够但脆：13 小时里一旦故障就全重来，多卡能并行缩短墙钟时间、加容错。代价是多卡引入 all-reduce 通信开销、利用率还会再降一点，要在成本和鲁棒间权衡。
why_en: One card suffices but is fragile — a 13-hour run lost to a crash restarts fully, so 2–4 GPUs cut wall-clock time and add fault tolerance.
options: 因为单卡显存一定放不下这个训练任务，必须堆更多卡才装得下
为通信留余量、加容错、缩短墙钟时间——单卡跑 13h 中途挂了要全重来
为了把 GPU 利用率从 40% 一路推到接近 100%，这样能省电又省钱
没必要，一张卡最省钱，老老实实跑满 13 小时就是最优选择
options_en: Because a single card definitely can't fit this training job in memory, so you must stack more cards.
To leave headroom for comms, add fault tolerance, and cut wall-clock — a 13-hour single-card run lost to a crash restarts fully.
To push GPU utilization from 40% all the way to near 100%, saving power and money.
No need — one card is cheapest, so just running it flat-out for 13 hours is the honestly optimal choice.
optionExplanations: 题目说单卡放得下，显存不是这里的瓶颈，堆卡的理由是容错和墙钟时间。
对；这笔多卡开销买的是更短的墙钟时间和抗单点故障的冗余，不是显存不够。
多卡反而因梯度同步通信开销，让利用率更低，不会到 100%，方向说反了。
单卡最便宜但最脆，13h 无冗余一挂全丢，生产不接受这种风险。
optionExplanations_en: The prompt says one card fits, so memory isn't the bottleneck; the reason is fault tolerance and wall-clock.
Correct — more GPUs buy robustness and shorter wall-clock at the cost of comms and lower utilization, a cost-robustness trade-off.
More GPUs actually lower utilization via all-reduce comms, never reaching 100% — direction reversed.
One card is cheapest but most fragile; 13h with no redundancy loses everything on a crash, unacceptable in prod.

termDefinitions.meaning: 任务实际经历的真实时间，多卡并行可缩短它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Wall-clock time is the real elapsed duration of a job, which parallel GPUs can shorten.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多卡同步梯度的集合通信，引入开销并压低利用率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: All-reduce is the gradient-sync collective across GPUs, adding overhead and lowering utilization.

q: 把训练时间估算的 worked example 排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the training-time worked example correctly:
steps: 总计算量 = 1e9 样本 × 2 GFLOPs × 3 epoch = 6e18 FLOPs
加通信 + 容错余量 → 实际配 2–4 张卡
取单卡峰值 312 TFLOPS × 利用率 40% ≈ 125e12 有效 FLOPS
why: 先由数据×epoch×每样本 FLOPs 得总工作量，再把峰值算力乘利用率因子得有效算力，相除得单卡时间，最后为通信和容错配 2–4 卡。
why_en: Compute total work from data×epochs×FLOPs-per-sample, scale peak by the utilization factor for effective compute, divide for single-card time, then provision 2–4 GPUs.

q: 以下哪些是 back-of-envelope 估算的经典低估陷阱？（多选）
q_en: Which of these are classic underestimation traps in back-of-the-envelope estimation? (multiple)
why: 三大低估都来自「把折扣项当没有」：GPU 利用率、优化器状态、副本/版本。用 1e9、2 的幂取整反而是好习惯，别当成错误。
why_en: The three traps all ignore a discount factor — GPU utilization, optimizer state, and replication — while aggressive rounding is good practice, not a trap.
options: 假设 GPU 利用率 100%（真实 30–50%，训练时间会低估 2–3×）
忘记优化器状态显存（训练是推理的 4–6×）
忽略副本/版本（生产存储常 3x 起，还要叠加多个模型版本）
用 1e9、2 的幂做粗略取整（这其实是推荐做法，不是陷阱）
options_en: Assuming 100% GPU utilization (real 30–50%, underestimating training time 2–3×).
Forgetting optimizer-state memory (training is 4–6× inference).
Ignoring replication/versioning (prod storage runs 3x+ and stacks multiple model versions).
Rounding with 1e9 and powers of 2 (this is recommended practice, not a trap).
optionExplanations: 对；100% 利用率是空想，漏乘 0.3~0.5 的因子会把训练时间低估几倍。
对；只算权重、漏梯度和优化器状态，会把训练显存低估 4–6 倍。
对；只报裸存储、漏副本和版本，是估存储最常见的系统性低估。
取整是加速心算、聚焦量级的好习惯，不是低估来源，所以不选。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — 100% utilization is fantasy; omitting the 0.3–0.5 factor underestimates training time several-fold.
Correct — counting only weights and dropping gradients/optimizer state underestimates training memory 4–6×.
Correct — reporting raw storage without replicas/versions is the classic systematic storage underestimate.
Rounding speeds mental math and focuses on magnitude — not an underestimate, so not selected.
scenario: 白板上你已算出 GPU 数和存储量，面试官追问：你这条链子哪里最可能把量级低估几倍？
scenario_en: You've whiteboarded a GPU count and a storage number, and the interviewer asks where your chain most likely underestimates by several times.

q: 估完做 sanity-check，手头该记住哪些基准数？
q_en: For a sanity-check after estimating, which benchmark numbers should you keep handy?
why: 记牢两个锚点：单张 A100 ≈ 80 GB HBM（能不能塞下模型的尺子）、GPT-3 = 175B 参数（模型规模的量级尺子）。HBM=High-Bandwidth Memory。它们是「让我核对一下」时对照的标杆。
why_en: Anchor on a single A100 ≈ 80 GB HBM and GPT-3 = 175B params, the yardsticks you compare against when sanity-checking.
options: 单张 A100 ≈ 8 GB HBM；GPT-3 = 1.75B 参数
单张 A100 ≈ 800 GB HBM；GPT-3 = 17.5B 参数
单张 A100 ≈ 80 GB HBM；GPT-3 = 175B 参数
单张 A100 ≈ 80 TB HBM；GPT-3 = 175M 参数
options_en: A single A100 ≈ 8 GB HBM; GPT-3 = 1.75B params.
A single A100 ≈ 800 GB HBM; GPT-3 = 17.5B params.
A single A100 ≈ 80 GB HBM; GPT-3 = 175B params.
A single A100 ≈ 80 TB HBM; GPT-3 = 175M params.

termDefinitions.meaning: GPU 高带宽显存，单张 A100 约 80 GB，是模型能否单卡装下的尺子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HBM (High-Bandwidth Memory) is GPU memory; an A100 has ~80 GB, the yardstick for single-card fit.

termDefinitions.meaning: 175B 参数的大模型，常用作模型规模量级的对照标杆。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GPT-3 (Generative Pre-trained Transformer 3) has 175B parameters, a common benchmark for model-scale magnitude.

scenario: 算完存储和显存的估算数字后，你想拿一个已知基准比一比，核对量级有没有错。
scenario_en: After computing your storage/memory estimates, you want to check them against a known benchmark to make sure the magnitude is right.
optionExplanations: A100 显存被缩小了 10 倍、GPT-3 参数也缩小了 100 倍，两个锚点都对不上真实规模。
A100 显存被放大了 10 倍、GPT-3 参数缩小了 10 倍，方向都记反了。
对，这就是常背的两个锚点，核对时直接拿来比对量级是否合理。
A100 显存夸大了 1000 倍、GPT-3 参数又缩小了近千倍，两个数量级都记反了。
optionExplanations_en: This shrinks the A100 by 10x and GPT-3's params by 100x — neither anchor matches real hardware or model scale.
This inflates the A100 by 10x and shrinks GPT-3 by 10x — both anchors point the wrong direction.
Right — these are the two go-to numbers, so you can eyeball whether your estimate is in the right ballpark.
This blows up the A100 by 1000x and shrinks GPT-3 by nearly as much — both magnitudes are backwards.

q: 估算题里最高信号的一句话动作是什么？
q_en: What is the highest-signal one-line move in an estimation question?
why: 算完主动说「让我对照一个已知基准核对一下」，把结果和 A100(80GB)/GPT-3(175B) 比一比。它展示你知道结果该落在什么量级、能自己抓离谱错误——这是资深信号。
why_en: Say 'let me sanity-check this against a known benchmark' and compare your result to A100 (80 GB) or GPT-3 (175B) — it shows you know the right order of magnitude.
options: 把小数点后面再多算出两三位小数，让最终数字显得更精确、更可信
算完主动说「让我核对个基准」，跟 A100/GPT-3 比一比
直接拒绝给出任何具体数字，反复只说「这个要看具体情况而定」
只报最终数字、完全不解释背后任何假设，让回答显得又快又利落
options_en: Compute a couple more decimal places so the final number looks more precise and more credible.
Proactively say 'let me check a benchmark' and compare the result to A100/GPT-3.
Flatly refuse to give any concrete number, just repeating 'it really depends' over and over.
Report only the final number with zero explained assumptions behind it, to look fast and slick.
optionExplanations: 多算小数位是伪精确，面试看的是量级对不对，不是位数多。
对；sanity-check 展示你有量级直觉、能自查离谱错误，是最高信号动作。
一味「看情况」不给量级，等于没展示估算能力。
不解释假设就没有推理链，快而空反而扣分。
optionExplanations_en: Extra decimals are false precision; interviews care about the right magnitude, not digit count.
Correct — a sanity-check shows magnitude intuition and self-correction, the highest-signal move.
Endless 'it depends' with no magnitude shows no estimation ability.
No stated assumptions means no chain; fast but empty loses points.
scenario: 你在白板上刚算出某模型推理要 350GB 显存，面试官不出声，等你的下一句话。
scenario_en: You've just worked out that a model needs 350 GB for inference, and the interviewer stays silent, waiting for your next sentence.

q: 除了给点估值，成熟的估算还应该体现哪两点运营意识？
q_en: Beyond a point estimate, which two operational instincts should a mature estimate show?
why: 把答案给成范围（承认输入是假设、有区间），并指出规模/数据分布漂移后需要周期性重估。范围体现不确定性，重估体现运营成熟度。
why_en: Frame answers as ranges to acknowledge uncertain inputs, and note that scale or distribution drift requires periodic re-estimation.
options: 把答案给成范围（承认不确定性），并指出漂移后要周期性重估
只给一个精确的点值，从此定下来就永远不再修改它
把每个输入假设都设成最坏情况，一律往死里高估以求心安
估一次就把结果锁死，之后的规模漂移交给下游团队自己扛
options_en: Give a range (acknowledging uncertainty) and note that drift requires periodic re-estimation.
Give one precise point value and, once set, never revise it again.
Set every input assumption to worst case and massively over-estimate just to feel safe.
Estimate once, lock the result, and leave later scale drift for downstream teams to handle.
optionExplanations: 对；范围体现输入是假设、结果有区间，重估体现你懂系统会随规模/分布漂移。
精确点值假装没有不确定性，且拒绝重估会随增长失真。
一律最坏情况会严重高估、浪费资源，不是成熟做法。
锁死不重估，规模一涨旧估值就失效，把风险甩给下游不专业。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a range admits assumed inputs and an interval, and re-estimation shows you know systems drift with scale/distribution.
A point value pretends there's no uncertainty, and refusing to revise decays as you grow.
Worst-casing everything grossly over-estimates and wastes resources, not a mature move.
Locking with no re-estimation lets old numbers rot as scale rises, dumping risk downstream.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户规模或数据分布随时间变化，使旧的容量估值失效，需周期性重估。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Drift is when user scale or data distribution shifts over time, invalidating old estimates and forcing periodic re-estimation.

scenario: 这份容量估算要交给容量规划团队当未来一年的采购依据，而用户规模仍在快速增长。
scenario_en: Your estimate will be handed to capacity planning as the basis for a year of purchasing, while user scale is still growing fast.

q: 补全这道自测：3B 模型 FP16 推理显存 =？
q_en: Fill in this self-check: 3B model, FP16 inference memory = ?
text: 小测：3B 参数模型 FP16 推理 = 3e9 × {{2}} = {{6}} GB。
text_en: Quick check: 3B-param model, FP16 inference = 3e9 × {{2}} = {{6}} GB.
why: 复用「参数 × bytes/param」：3e9 × 2 = 6 GB（FP16 = 2 字节/参数）。能秒答说明模型大小公式已经内化。
why_en: Reuse params × bytes/param: 3e9 × 2 = 6 GB, and answering instantly means the model-size formula is internalized.
scenario: 边缘盒子只有 8GB 显存，产品想上一个 3B 模型做 FP16 推理，先判断塞不塞得下。
scenario_en: An edge box has only 8 GB of memory and the product wants a 3B model doing FP16 inference, so first check whether it fits.

q: 估算时为什么要主动用 1e9、2 的幂来粗略取整？
q_en: Why deliberately round with 1e9 and powers of 2 during estimation?
why: 目标是量级正确、可复查的推理链，不是精确数值。圆整数字让每步都能口算、面试官能跟上你的链条——速度优先于精度。
why_en: The goal is an order-of-magnitude, checkable chain, so round numbers keep every step mentally computable and easy to follow.
options: 因为最终必须精确到个位，取整只是中间步骤的临时手段
追求速度胜过精度：量级对了就够，圆整数字让心算和链条清晰
因为 GPU 硬件只能处理 2 的幂，非整数会直接报错
取整会让答案错一个量级，其实应该尽量避免、保留全部小数
options_en: Because the final answer must be exact to the unit; rounding is only a temporary mid-step device.
Speed over precision: getting the magnitude right suffices, and round numbers keep mental math and the chain clear.
Because GPU hardware only handles powers of 2, so non-round numbers error out.
Rounding throws the answer off by an order of magnitude and should be avoided by keeping all decimals.
optionExplanations: 面试要的是量级不是个位精度，取整是主线做法不是临时补丁。
对；圆整数字加速心算、让推理链清晰，速度优先才对得上评分点。
取整是心算方便，跟 GPU 只能处理 2 的幂毫无关系。
合理取整不会错量级，反而保留一堆小数会拖慢、掩盖推理链。
optionExplanations_en: Interviews want magnitude, not unit precision; rounding is the main method, not a patch.
Correct — round numbers speed mental math and clarify the chain, and speed-first matches the grading.
Rounding is for mental ease and has nothing to do with GPUs only handling powers of 2.
Sensible rounding doesn't lose the magnitude; keeping many decimals just slows and obscures the chain.
scenario: 白板估算限时 5 分钟、没有计算器，面试官要跟着你每一步一起口算复核。
scenario_en: A whiteboard estimate with five minutes and no calculator, and the interviewer wants to follow and re-do every step in their head.

scenario: 面试官问「服务 1B 用户的 embedding 要多少存储？」你要先挑对四支柱里的公式。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks 'how much storage to serve 1B user embeddings?' — first pick the right pillar's formula.
q: 这是四支柱里的哪一类，用哪个公式？
q_en: Which pillar is this, and which formula applies?
why: 「存 1B 用户向量」是数据侧规模题 → 用存储公式：实体数 × 维度 × 每浮点字节 × 副本。先认出问的是哪根支柱，再套对应公式，别把模型大小和存储混。
why_en: Storing 1B user vectors is a data-side sizing question, so use the storage formula: entities × dim × bytes × replication.
tradeoff: 存储公式（数据侧：实体×维度×副本） vs 模型大小公式（模型侧：参数×精度）
options: 模型大小：参数 × 每参数字节，直接给出模型本体多大
吞吐：峰值 QPS ÷ 单卡吞吐，算要几张 GPU 服务
存储估算：实体数 × 维度 × 每浮点字节 × 副本
训练时间：总计算量 ÷ 有效算力，算训练要多久
options_en: Model size: params × bytes/param, giving how big the model itself is.
Throughput: peak QPS ÷ per-GPU throughput, sizing the GPU fleet.
Storage: num_entities × dim × bytes_per_float × replication.
Training time: total FLOPs ÷ effective FLOPS, how long training takes.
whenOtherWins: 若问的是「模型本身多大」而非「存所有用户向量」，就切到模型大小公式：参数 × 每参数字节。
optionExplanations: 模型大小算的是模型本体，不是存 1B 用户向量的数据量，问错支柱。
吞吐算 GPU 张数，不是算存储容量，和「要多少存储」不对题。
对；存 1B 用户向量是数据规模题，用存储公式，别忘乘副本。
训练时间是算时长的支柱，跟存储容量无关，问错公式。
optionExplanations_en: Model size measures the model itself, not the data volume of 1B user vectors — wrong pillar.
Throughput sizes the GPU count, not storage capacity — off-topic for 'how much storage'.
Correct — storing 1B user vectors is a data-scale question; use the storage formula and don't forget replication.
Training time is the duration pillar, unrelated to storage capacity — wrong formula.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒查询数，吞吐支柱的需求侧基数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: QPS (Queries Per Second) is the demand-side base of the throughput pillar.

scenario: 要训练一个大模型，既想省显存/提速，又要保持训练稳定收敛。
scenario_en: Training a large model while saving memory/speed and keeping training stable and convergent.
q: 主流做法用什么精度组合？
q_en: What precision combination is the mainstream choice?
why: 混合精度：用 FP16/BF16 算前向反向提速省显存，同时保留 FP32 主权重和优化器状态防止梯度下溢/精度累积误差。这也解释了训练 ≈16 bytes/param 里权重+动量按 FP32 存。
why_en: Mixed precision: compute forward/backward in FP16/BF16 for speed while keeping an FP32 master copy of weights and optimizer state for stability.
tradeoff: 混合精度（省显存/快、需 FP32 主副本保稳） vs 全 FP32（最稳、最占显存最慢）
options: 全程 FP32：训练最稳，但显存占用和训练速度都是最差的
全程 INT8：训练时也把权重和梯度都量化到 1 byte，最省显存
混合精度：FP16/BF16 算前向反向，FP32 存主权重和优化器状态
全程 FP16：连主权重和优化器状态也统一只用半精度存
options_en: All FP32: most stable during training, but memory footprint and training speed are both worst.
All INT8: quantize both weights and gradients to 1 byte during training too, saving the most memory.
Mixed precision: FP16/BF16 for forward/backward, FP32 master weights and optimizer state.
All FP16: keep even master weights and optimizer state uniformly in half precision.
whenOtherWins: 若硬件不支持半精度或数值极不稳定，才退回全 FP32；纯推理部署才用 INT8。
optionExplanations: 全 FP32 稳但最占显存最慢，题目要省显存提速，它不划算。
INT8 是推理量化，训练时量化到 1 byte 会破坏收敛，用错场景。
对；FP16/BF16 提速省显存 + FP32 主副本保稳，是训练标准做法。
全 FP16 连主权重都半精度会梯度下溢、收敛不稳，所以要留 FP32 主副本。
optionExplanations_en: All FP32 is stable but heaviest and slowest; the goal is saving memory/speed, so it's not worth it.
INT8 is inference quantization; quantizing to 1 byte during training breaks convergence — wrong scenario.
Correct — FP16/BF16 for speed/memory plus an FP32 master copy for stability is the standard training recipe.
All-FP16 master weights cause gradient underflow and unstable convergence, which is why an FP32 master copy is kept.

termDefinitions.meaning: 前向反向用 FP16/BF16 提速省显存，主权重和优化器状态保留 FP32 保稳。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Mixed precision computes forward/backward in FP16/BF16 for speed while keeping FP32 master weights and optimizer state for stability.

termDefinitions.meaning: 16 位浮点，动态范围比 FP16 大，混合精度训练常用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BF16 (Brain Floating Point 16) is a 16-bit float with wider dynamic range than FP16, common in mixed-precision training.
